contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP TRAIANO AVG GER DAC PM [TR P] ; R/ COS V PP SE[--]OPTIMO PRINC

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), probably Sear vol. 2 no. 3132, mint of Rome, citing RIC vol. 2 no. 147a, issue of 103-111. Obverse description: Bust laurate draped right, few leaves on wreath so might be a diadem. Obverse inscription: IMP TRAIANO AVG GER DAC PM [TR P]. Reverse description: Trophy of arms, two shields at top and two smaller below. Reverse inscription: COS V PP…
